content: We conducted experiments on ROTOWIRE BIBREF2. For each example, it provides three tables as described in Section SECREF2 which consists of 628 records in total with a long game summary. The average length of game summary is 337.1. In this paper, we followed the data split introduced in Wiseman: 3398 examples in training set, 727 examples in development set and 728 examples in test set. We followed Wiseman's work and use BLEU BIBREF7 and three extractive evaluation metrics RG, CS and CO BIBREF2 for evaluation. The main idea of the extractive evaluation metrics is to use an Information Extraction (IE) model to identify records mentioned in texts. Then compare them with tables or records extracted from reference to evaluate the model. RG (Relation Generation) measures content fidelity of texts. CS (Content Selection) measures model's ability on content selection. CO (Content Ordering) measures model's ability on ordering the chosen records in texts. We refer the readers to Wiseman's paper for more details.
